item.title: The Embassy Appoints Steve Woo as Head of Studio
item.description: Independent creative studio The Embassy welcomes Steve Woo as Head of Studio. Steve began his career producing and directing features, TV, and commercials, while always holding VFX as a passion of his. In 2004, he started a VFX studio in Taiwan, and was later hired as Head of Studio in China by Digital Domain, helping to manage their global studios.
